hint: Surat va maxrajdan $$2^x$$ qavsdan tashqariga chiqariladi: $$\frac{2^x(2^2 - 1)}{2^x(2 + 1)} = \frac{2^2 - 1}{2 + 1} = 2 - 1 = 1$$.
